summary: High-quality real-time lip-sync via MuseTalk. Requires an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA) and Python 3.10+. MIT-licensed, commercial use OK. On first use it installs its PyTorch runtime and downloads model weights (several GB) into the add-on cache.
author: Subtitld

fields.label: MuseTalk version
fields.help: MuseTalk model version. 1.5 gives sharper mouths; 1.0 is the original.

fields.label: Bbox shift
fields.help: Shifts the face crop vertically to tune mouth openness. Positive opens the mouth more, negative closes it. MuseTalk 1.0 only.

fields.label: Extra margin
fields.help: Extra pixels added below the face crop (jaw region). MuseTalk 1.5 only.

fields.label: Batch size
fields.help: Frames generated per UNet forward pass. Higher is faster but needs more VRAM; lower it on 'oom' errors.

fields.label: Output FPS
fields.help: Frame rate of the generated video. MuseTalk is trained at 25 fps; leave at 25 for best results.

fields.label: Use float16
fields.help: Run the UNet/VAE in fp16 to cut VRAM use. Disable if you see numerical artifacts.
